observations: A large face fills most of the frame against a mid-blue field; tan-grey flat patches mark the forehead, cheeks, and chin, while a thick black outline defines the jaw and left side of the head.

Yellow zigzag and jagged lines radiate across the upper half and background, with a continuous yellow stroke running horizontally across the top of the face; a pink line traces the nose bridge down to a dark red mouth.
Two hands appear at lower left and lower right, rendered in the same tan-grey as the face patches; loose black scribble lines and pink angular marks scatter across the lower third of the composition.
reading: Blue fills every gap between the face and the edges, pressing the figure forward. The tan patches read as planes, but the yellow zigzags crossing them feel more like interference than light. A pink line runs from brow to lip, pulling the eye down to a red mouth that sits still against all that noise. The raised hands neither reach nor defend; they hold their place.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors #294 and #296 share the same large-face format. #294 uses a dark grey field; #296 shifts to saturated yellow. #295 sits between them as the blue version of that recurring structure.
